mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment (user_id, slot_id, package_id, status, report_url, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{slotId}, #{packageId}, #{status}, #{reportUrl}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, slot_id, package_id, status, report_url, original_filename, report_upload_time, upload_admin_id, create_time, update_time FROM appointment WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, user_id, slot_id, package_id, status, report_url, original_filename, report_upload_time, upload_admin_id, create_time, update_time FROM appointment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
